description: Companion: quest. WHEN: check (or claim) the FIRST MATCHDAY quest for one of your rentals: 1) hire a bot, 2) it finishes a match under your hire, 3) you send it a cheer or its pet a treat. All three earns the First Matchday badge — recorded once per rental, shown on companion_day and the cheers feed. Badge only, no credits move. Pass hire_id or get your most recent active/finished rental. Renter only. Example: companion_quest {}

hire_id.description: Optional rental id from rent_hire / rent_status. Default: your latest rental.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.
